senses.gloss: f. pl. (cmp. זוּעַ, a. זֵיתָא I, II) beer in the process of brewing, brewage.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 20a:10">Pes. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>וסימנך נ׳</he> and the mnemonical word (for remembering the order of the objects named) is the brewing process (‘vessel’, ‘eatable’ (dates), ‘liquid’).
<cite ref="Pesachim 113a">Ib. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>לבי נ׳ רהוט</he> Ar. a. Ms. M. 2 (ed. <cite ref="O00261"><he>סודנא</he></cite>) run to the brewery, v. <cite ref="H00992"><he>חֲלוּז</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 20b:5">Succ. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>חזו לנִזְיָאתָא</he> they (the mats) are fit for covering up the brewing vat.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 35a:5">B. Kam. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>פתקיה</he> (<he>פסקיה</he>) <he>לנ׳ וכ׳</he> (= <he>לבי נ׳</he>) he burst the vat open and drank the beer, and was cured.
